name: Gojra

queries.query: Gojra Pakistan official land records cadastral map parcel Punjab Land Records Authority
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA), the PULSE Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement viewer, the official PULSE cadastral-map program, and the Toba Tek Singh district administration. The PULSE viewer's current HTML/JavaScript identifies a Punjab cadastral MapServer, but anonymous ArcGIS REST metadata requests returned Token Required and no parcel geometry was retrieved.

queries.result: Urdu-language first-party discovery did not expose a separate Gojra parcel API. The official PLRA site and Urdu/English registry login pages describe Punjab land-record services; the public PULSE viewer remains the only identified map route. No login, CAPTCHA, owner lookup, or unsafe field request was attempted.

officialSources.observation: Official Punjab Land Records Authority site. It describes PLRA as the Government of Punjab land-record authority and lists digital land-record, Fard, registry, and Arazi Record Centre services.

Official PULSE public map viewer. Its current JavaScript configuration identifies https://gismaps.punjab-zameen.gov.pk/arcgis/rest/services/VendorMaps/Punjab_Cdastral_Maps/MapServer as the Punjab cadastral map layer and states that complete parcel details require login.
Official PULSE program site describing parcel-based mapping, records digitization, and cadastral maps for Punjab.

Official district administration page confirming Gojra as one of the district's four tehsils and describing revenue administration through the district revenue officials, tehsil officers, and patwaris.
Official PLRA procurement document listing an Arazi Record Center for Tehsil Gojra at the Tehsil Office, District Toba Tek Singh. This is local custodian evidence, not a public parcel geometry feed.
